original_prompt:
[Style] Shaky tourist phone video at dusk, just after sunset. No colour filter: warm orange firelight and cool blue twilight light mix in the same frame.

[Visual] A small lava fountain shoots up from a crack in a black volcanic field. It throws arcs of glowing molten drops against a deep cool-blue sky. Two onlookers in windbreaker jackets stand at a safe distance in the foreground, with their backs to the camera. The sides of their jackets facing the fountain glow warm orange. The sides facing the camera sit in cool blue shadow. The rocks near the camera are black, with a rough, rope-like, wrinkled crust. The edges of the rocks facing the lava glow orange. The tops of the rocks facing the sky are lit cool blue. A fresh surge of lava sends glowing blobs tumbling down the crusted slope. Drops of molten spatter land on the rock and slowly dim. The handheld phone tilts up from behind the onlookers as the fountain climbs higher. The biggest surge comes around the halfway point of the clip.

[Sounds] Deep continuous rumble, hissing as the lava lands on the rock, wind hitting the phone microphone.

[Avoid] The frame never gets one single uniform colour tone; warm and cool light stay mixed. The rock surface never turns smooth or plastic-looking; its wrinkled texture stays sharp. No subtitles.
ability_evaluation_criteria: Lighting and material seem realistic and behaves as prompted
